# Deep Research Intelligence Packet

## Cycle metadata

- Packet ID: `dr-20260922-2207-bite-validation`
- Research system: `ChatGPT Deep Research`
- Started at: `2026-09-22 22:07 CDT`
- Completed at: `2026-09-22 22:10 CDT`
- Research scope: Direct-competitor customer-page mining
- Queue item or vendor: `competitor:bite`
- Methodology: Four first-party Bite customer and case-study pages were opened and assessed. Vendor-authored results remain attributed claims and were not written into canonical records.

## Executive result

- Pages reviewed: 4
- Candidate pages validated: 4
- Brand-vendor-product observations added or revised: 4
- Conflicts found: 1
- Material takeaway: Bite has named kiosk deployments ranging from all five Tiki Taco locations to 16 of 43 Urbane Cafe locations, plus older named-customer evidence for Crazy Bowls & Wraps and an early-stage Bonchon rollout. The evidence supports kiosk ordering and specific integrations, but not a broad systemwide footprint beyond the stated scopes.

## Evidence observations

### Observation 1

- Brand: Urbane Cafe
- Vendor: Bite
- Product or category: Self-service kiosks; Thanx loyalty integration
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: regional
- Evidence type: case study
- Confidence: 95%
- Confidence rationale: Bite's dated first-party case study names an Urbane Cafe marketing executive, a recent three-month measurement period, and 16 live kiosk locations out of 43 total.
- Source title: Urbane Cafe: How Guest-First Kiosk Technology Drove a 22% Lift in Check Average Across 16 Locations
- Source URL: https://blog.getbite.com/articles/urbane-cafe-how-guest-first-kiosk-technology-drove-a-22-lift-in-check-average-across-16-locations
- Publisher or source owner: Bite
- Published date, if known: 2026-03-05
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The case study reports 16 live Bite kiosk locations during October 14, 2025 through January 14, 2026, and says every new Urbane Cafe build now includes Bite kiosks.
- Product-specific evidence: Bite kiosks were integrated with Thanx loyalty so guests could identify themselves and access rewards at the kiosk.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Only 16 of 43 locations were live in the measured period; “every new build” does not mean the full existing estate was deployed. Performance results are vendor-authored.
- Recommended follow-up: Confirm the current live-location count and POS/payment integrations directly with Urbane Cafe.

### Observation 2

- Brand: Tiki Taco
- Vendor: Bite
- Product or category: Self-service kiosks; AI recommendations; group ordering
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: enterprise
- Evidence type: case study
- Confidence: 95%
- Confidence rationale: Bite's dated case study names Tiki Taco's CEO and explicitly states deployment in all five locations.
- Source title: How Bite's Agility and Partnership Approach Drove a Kiosk Switch for Tiki Taco
- Source URL: https://blog.getbite.com/articles/how-bites-agility-and-partnership-approach-drove-a-kiosk-switch-for-tiki-taco
- Publisher or source owner: Bite
- Published date, if known: 2026-01-16
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The page says Bite powers all five Tiki Taco locations and delivered a group-ordering enhancement within seven days.
- Product-specific evidence: Self-service ordering, group-order ticket separation, upsell and recommendation logic, on-site deployment support, and reported kiosk-versus-cashier performance.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: The overview says all five locations use Bite, while the performance footnote covers four active kiosks during January 1 through October 31, 2025. Treat the performance figures as four-kiosk-period data, not five-location results.
- Recommended follow-up: Confirm whether every location currently has one or more live kiosks and identify the integrated POS, loyalty, and payment products.

### Observation 3

- Brand: Crazy Bowls & Wraps
- Vendor: Bite
- Product or category: Self-service kiosks
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: unknown
- Evidence type: testimonial
- Confidence: 75%
- Confidence rationale: Bite hosts a named customer page with a testimonial from the brand's former COO of IT, but the page is undated and does not state how many of the 16 units deployed kiosks.
- Source title: Crazy Bowls
- Source URL: https://www.getbite.com/case-studies/crazy-bowls
- Publisher or source owner: Bite
- Published date, if known: unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The former COO of IT describes a Bite partnership, kiosk check-average growth, labor reallocation, and improved order accuracy.
- Product-specific evidence: Restaurant self-service kiosks with menu filtering and customization.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Currentness and deployed-location count are unspecified; the executive title is marked former, and the 38% check-average claim is vendor-hosted.
- Recommended follow-up: Verify whether the deployment is still active and obtain the current location count and integrations.

### Observation 4

- Brand: Bonchon
- Vendor: Bite
- Product or category: Self-service kiosks
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: franchisee
- Evidence type: press release
- Confidence: 75%
- Confidence rationale: Bite's dated first-party news page explicitly calls the relationship a partnership and describes kiosks being introduced at existing and new U.S. stores, but gives no deployed-site count.
- Source title: Bonchon Opens 150th US Store & Introduced New Bite Kiosks
- Source URL: https://blog.getbite.com/articles/bonchon-opens-150th-us-store-introduced-new-bite-kiosks
- Publisher or source owner: Bite
- Published date, if known: 2025-03-04
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The page says many existing and new Bonchon stores were introducing Bite kiosks and that tests produced higher check totals and guest satisfaction.
- Product-specific evidence: Bite self-service kiosk ordering in the U.S. franchise system.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: This is early-rollout language, not evidence of deployment across all 150 U.S. stores; no current count or technical integrations are named.
- Recommended follow-up: Check Bonchon's franchise technology standards and current kiosk rollout count.

## Negative findings

- Candidate or claim: Bite has an enterprise-wide deployment across every named customer estate.
- Pages checked: All four pages in the source ledger.
- Result: Unsupported. Tiki Taco is explicitly all five locations; Urbane Cafe was 16 of 43 during the measured period; Crazy Bowls & Wraps gives no deployment count; Bonchon describes adoption by many existing and new stores rather than the entire system.

## Source ledger

| URL | Source type | Accessed | Supports observation(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| https://blog.getbite.com/articles/urbane-cafe-how-guest-first-kiosk-technology-drove-a-22-lift-in-check-average-across-16-locations | case study | 2026-09-22 | 1 | Productive; recent measured scope and Thanx integration. |
| https://blog.getbite.com/articles/how-bites-agility-and-partnership-approach-drove-a-kiosk-switch-for-tiki-taco | case study | 2026-09-22 | 2 | Productive; all-location claim, with four-active-kiosk result period. |
| https://www.getbite.com/case-studies/crazy-bowls | testimonial | 2026-09-22 | 3 | Productive but undated and scope-limited. |
| https://blog.getbite.com/articles/bonchon-opens-150th-us-store-introduced-new-bite-kiosks | press release | 2026-09-22 | 4 | Productive early-rollout evidence; no systemwide inference. |

## Research notes and inferences

- Inference: Bite's strongest visible proof is in kiosk ordering for small and midsize fast-casual chains, with integration value appearing important. This packet does not establish a core POS replacement role.
- Inference: The Tiki Taco case suggests support responsiveness and custom feature delivery are part of Bite's competitive positioning, but the unnamed predecessor cannot be identified safely from this evidence.
